PORTAL PROTOTYPE FIX — REPORT

Project 57bf60cf-5e6d-450f-9e2f-e25c8d12fd66 ("Tahi dashboard"). 16 files written, every one verified byte-for-byte by re-downloading it from the serve URL and diffing against the local copy. Zero console errors on every surface, in every combination walked.

═══════════════════════════════════════
1. CSS NAMESPACE COLLISION (root cause)
═══════════════════════════════════════

portal-files.css / .jsx / -kit.jsx / -data.jsx
- Renamed every `.pf-*` to `.pfl-*` (526 CSS occurrences, 226 JSX occurrences) and every `.pm-*` to `.pfm-*` (54 CSS, 28 JSX). The root wrapper moved too: `.pf` → `.pfl`, and the Messages root `'pf pm'` → `'pfl pfm'` (that combined root was pulling `.pm{display:block}` out of portal-money.css over the top of `.pf{display:flex}`, which is what flattened the Messages two-pane).
- I did NOT collapse the messages classes into `pfl-` as the brief literally said: `.pf-body`, `.pf-row` and `.pf-thread` already existed alongside `.pm-body`, `.pm-row` and `.pm-thread` in the same file, so a single target would have re-created the collision inside one module. `pfl-` = the drive, `pfm-` = the Messages two pane.
- Also renamed the colliding globals the class rename would have missed: `@keyframes pf-fade` and `pf-pulse` (both defined in home AND files) plus the custom property `--pf-tint`.

Verification (all measured, not asserted):
- shared class names, all six module pairs: 0 / 0 / 0 / 0 / 0 / 0
- duplicate `@keyframes` names across the four portal stylesheets: 0
- `pf-` or `pm-` tokens left anywhere in the files module: 0 (three remaining hits are prose in the file header comments explaining the rule)
- `pm-` is used only by portal-money.* and (as prose) portal-files.*; nothing else in the project uses `pf-`, `pm-`, `pfl-` or `pfm-` (grepped all 25 non-portal jsx/css files too)

Downstream effects confirmed by render: Home has no horizontal overflow (`.pf-scroll` scrollWidth 1200 == clientWidth 1200, was 1074-in-1040); Recently delivered / Recent files / Your team / The pieces of this request / Files on this request all render full-width rows with no empty first column; the Files grid is four cards per row again; Messages is a working two-pane; avatar wrappers keep the leaf.

═══ CROSS-CUTTING, WORTH MORE THAN ANY SINGLE PAGE ═══

1. Dark mode small text fails contrast everywhere. --text-faint is #6B6A63 in both themes (app-shell.css defines the same value in the dark block). Against dark surfaces that measures 2.93 to 3.45 to 1 on 10px to 12px text. It hits every eyebrow label (STILL TO PAY, NEXT DUE, RATE, TRACKS RUNNING, WHAT IS INCLUDED), every table header (INVOICE / STATUS / ISSUED / DUE / AMOUNT), every request id (TR-1049 and friends at 3.17), every timestamp and every count. Full lists in the probe output. This is a token bug, not a page bug: dark needs its own faint value around #8A8880.

2. Every primary button fails contrast in dark. White on --brand #7AAB6B measures 2.67 to 1 at 13px. That is Start a request, New request, New message, Upload, Pay, and the "1 new" / "New" badges. In dark the brand token lightens, so the label should flip to dark ink (#131211), which gives roughly 9 to 1. This is the single most visible dark-mode defect in the portal.

3. The same person is drawn three ways. portal-home .pf-av is a leaf (0px 7px), portal-files and messages .pfl-av is a circle (50%), portal-account .pa-av is a leaf at 64px and a circle at 36px on the same page. The namespace split made this permanent: nobody will ever notice the three Av components drifted. One Av in a shared kit, one shape.

4. The Tweaks pill is position:fixed bottom right and sits over the Messages Send button and the Services footer. The fixer flagged it and was right to; it is the same class of scaffolding as the states pill that got deleted.

5. Ana's avatar teal #2C8C7C with white initials is 4.08 to 1, marginally under 4.5. Darkening it one step clears it and keeps her distinct from Staci's amber.

═══ SUMMARY ═══
SHIP: request-detail, messages, invoices-list, invoice-detail, notifications, account, offline
FIX: home, requests-list, services, onboarding, files (mobile only)

The single highest-value action is re-uploading portal-home-kit.jsx, which silently never deployed and is the reason a client currently sees internal scaffolding copy when they try to file a request. After that, the two dark-mode token fixes, since they touch every page at once.
